GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 3 Lengths , sat last rails off poor start 8 Lengths 800m, came to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up but did not finish race off # always last
( winkers off, Blinkers again) Jumped Ok was Wide With Cover 5 Lengths from Leader . came widest in Straight , Held Ground before tiring # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( winkers again) stood flatfooted missing it 4-5 Lengths , ended up worse than Mid Field 9 Lengths . saved ground into Straight now 5 Lengths from the Leader , worked to line fairly without looking a threat # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: stood flat-footed as the start was affected and lost considerable ground. Co-trainers, Mr D. and Mrs A. Magro, were advised that the mare would now be required to jump away with the field in an Official Barrier Trial prior to a future race start. Tightened near the 900m and obliged to be steadied. Laid out rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: stood flat footed and missed kick 6 Lengths , long last off poor start 15 Lengths 800m, stayed there, winkers off again # blew start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stood flat footed as the start was effected and missed the start by several lengths. Near the 900m was hampered by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 5 Lengths , Clear last 12 Lengths 700m, never in race # never close
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: stood flat-footed as the start was affected and was then slow to muster early speed and as a result lost further ground. Co-trainer, Mr D. Magro, was advised that  a warning had been placed on the mare.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: stood flatfooted missing it 2 Lengths , ended up Wide No Cover & moved to Mid Field bit keen 4 Lengths . was inclined to lay in on entering Straight , Couldn't Go On # there were excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: As the start was affected stood flat footed and lost ground. Raced wide  without cover for majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field Wide With Cover 6 Lengths . Straightened Up the widest runner, Made Some Ground mostly Hands And Heels # ok but no threat

Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover 4 Lengths 800m, came off heels Four Wide Straightening Up but she Just looked to be battling until last 100m when she found another gear and powered over them late for exciting win, Tongue Tie off first time, visors off first time, winkers again # tough grinding win

Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled back in second half rails 8 Lengths 600m, got off fence before the corner and in Clear Middle Of Track when balanced-up, kept grinding away under riding and although never close to first couple ran into minor placing # ran into placing

Slow Out 2 Lengths , Clear last off poor start 10 Lengths 600m, still well off them staying back inside Straightening Up , weaved off fence last 100m and made late ground in tight room, blinkers off again, visors first time # got going late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: slow to begin and shortly after was hampered when contacted by a/r, which had been taken out. Forced to race in restricted room over the concluding 50m of the event between runners, which both shifted slightly.
